method: Browser fetch from a desktop browser on routing.openstreetmap.de (FOSSGIS-hosted OSRM, non-commercial test service). Requests spaced >1.1 s apart. Cloud build container could not reach the host (egress 403), so these were run from the user's linked desktop browser.

multiStop.query: King's Cross (-0.1240,51.5308) -> St Paul's (-0.0984,51.5138) -> Tate Modern (-0.0994,51.5076), alternatives=true
multiStop.finding: Multi-stop requests return one route with one leg per stop. No alternatives were returned with an intermediate stop in any profile. Each leg ends with an 'arrive' manoeuvre.

avoidances.intersectionClasses: No intersection 'classes' were present in any returned step, so the test graph cannot disclose whether a route uses a toll, motorway or ferry.
avoidances.finding: The hosted test car graph supports no avoidances. NEXORA therefore ships avoidances disabled by default and only forwards exclude classes an operator declares in NEXORA_CAR_EXCLUDE for a self-hosted graph built with them.
